product_one_liner.value: Upstage provides large language models and document-processing AI that help enterprises extract information and automate document-heavy business workflows.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 260 employees as of September 30, 2026; older directories report lower counts.

eng_blog.notes: The Dataverse post is co-written by AI Research Engineer Chanjun Park; the Ko-LLM leaderboard post presents technical explanations from its LLM technical leader and research engineer in interview form.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: AI Research Engineer - Agents & Workflows.

model_provider.value: Upstage Solar models, including Solar Pro 4; OpenAI and Microsoft Azure are also disclosed as model-inference providers.
model_provider.notes: Provider usage varies by service; OpenAI API compatibility alone is not treated as evidence of OpenAI model usage.

compliance_certs.notes: The Studio page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 1 and ISO 27001 certification and HIPAA compliance; HIPAA is a compliance claim rather than a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest confirmed investment: JB Financial affiliates committed KRW 40 billion in the first tranche of Series C-2, announced October 20, 2026; the cited report gives its USD equivalent as $29.8 million. NVIDIA participation announced November 9 was prospective, with amount undisclosed, and is not treated as a completed additional closing.

raised_18mo.notes: Upstage announced completion of a $45 million Series B bridge in August 2025, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: SDR (Sales Development Representative, one-year fixed-term contract).

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage Studio launched October 6, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jin Yun-jeong joined as CFO in March 2026, according to the April 2026 report; the June report also confirms her appointment.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly names Salesforce and HubSpot in its CRM/sales-automation experience requirement; it does not establish which is the exclusive production CRM.
